M1.reason: Measured overlap is under 0.80 in every pair: front/back 0.779, left/right 0.585, top/below 0.572. The worst part is the front legs. On the original they are jointed claws that reach forward and down from the shell. On the reproduction they are stiff rods that go straight out at the top of the shell and then drop vertically, so the left and right views show a hooked rod sticking above and in front of the body. The rear legs are short stubs where the original's splay outward, so the top view is a rounded oval where the original is a wide, waisted shape.

M2.reason: Reproduction is 25.7 x 18.8 x 13.3 against the original's 25.9 x 19.2 x 13.2. Every axis is within about 2%, well inside 10%.

M3.reason: The main parts are there: a pale dome at the front, a tan carapace behind it, four legs and a mouth underneath. Their shapes are clearly off. The front legs are straight rod-and-blade pieces, not segmented claws. The rear legs are short red stubs with small claws, not the original's splayed jointed legs. In the below view the original's mouth is a toothed, fleshy maw with folds around it. The reproduction has a flat dark red panel with an octagonal disc, and a separate row of small teeth along the shell's bottom edge.

M4.reason: The colour regions are in the right places: cream dome, tan or brown shell, red legs, red underside. The measured mean delta E is 21.1 and every view is above 15 (17.2 to 22.7). The reproduction's shell is a flat light tan where the original's is darker, mottled brown and ochre. The legs are flat crimson where the original's are mottled orange-red and brown. The underside reads as a solid dark red block, not the original's mixed flesh tones.

M5.reason: Some detail is there: red vein lines on the dome and scored panel lines on the carapace in the top and back views. The original's grainy, mottled shell texture is missing. So are the ribbed segment markings on its back, the blotchy texture on the legs, and the detailed teeth and flesh of the mouth underneath. The reproduction's surfaces are mostly smooth flat colour with sparse line marks.

M6.reason: At game size the reproduction reads as a headcrab-like creature, with a cream dome, tan shell and red legs. The rod-shaped front legs, which stick up and out then hang straight down, plus its smooth, flat-shaded look, set it clearly apart from the original's crouched, clawed, heavily textured body. A player side by side would not take it for the original.

M7.reason: The dome faces front as on the original, the model is upright, and it rests on its legs and lower edge at the same height as the original. The front, back, left and right views line up with the original's.

M8.reason: SMAK's check reports no errors and nothing looks open, inside out or floating. It has 980 triangles against the original's 478, which is 2.05 times, just over the limit of twice.
